test_title: PYST 20: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 02 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Rearrange the parts of the sentence in the correct order.

Tourism
P. and cultural exchange
Q. by creating jobs
R. contributes significantly to the economy
S. promoting local businesses,
solution:
The correct answer is** Option (1)** i.e. **RQSP**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence begins with the subject "Tourism" and continues with part (R): "contributes significantly to the economy." This provides a clear statement of its importance.
 
• Part (Q) follows logically: "by creating jobs." This explains one of the ways tourism contributes to the economy.
 
• Part (S) continues the sequence: "promoting local businesses," adding another way tourism benefits the economy.
 
• Finally, part (P): "and cultural exchange" completes the sentence by adding the cultural aspect of tourism.

Therefore, the correct answer is **RQSP.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2 (PSQR):** This option places "and cultural exchange" at the beginning, which disrupts the logical flow of the sentence.
 
• **Option 3 (SPQR):** This option starts with "promoting local businesses," which is less impactful as an opening and does not prioritize the main subject, tourism.
 
• **Option 4 (QRSP):** This option begins with "by creating jobs," which makes the sentence incomplete and does not establish tourism as the subject of the sentence.
</ul
